retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast urban aesthetic featuring multiple subjects in black attire against a background of oversized industrial chains and geometric, stylized typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A dynamic composition featuring three men in black urban fashion, anchored by a large foreground figure holding a chrome chain, set against a backdrop of massive, desaturated industrial links and sharp, geometric graphic elements.
coreVisualRelationships: Foreground subject scale vs background chain scale
High-contrast black clothing against light industrial background
Geometric typography integrated with subject poses
Repetition of chain motifs across depth planes
coreInvariants: Oversized industrial chain links as a primary background motif
High-contrast studio lighting with deep shadows on black clothing
Geometric, non-traditional letterforms with sharp angles

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Primary subject is large and right-aligned in the foreground; secondary subjects are smaller and distributed to the left and center-bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The foreground subject's face and the chrome chain held horizontally across the chest.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the large foreground face, along the horizontal chain to the left subject, then down to the central subject and the vertical typography.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Limited negative space, filled with large-scale chain links and high-key background areas.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black for clothing and shadows
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Off-white and light grey for the industrial background
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Chrome silver for chains and white for graphic text
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with extreme value contrast between subjects and background.

letterConstructionRules: Use of parallel vertical bars for stems
Varying heights within a single word
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters composed of multiple vertical strokes
Triangular or slanted terminals for horizontal elements
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Combine ultra-geometric custom display type with slanted, blocky secondary text.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the multi-bar construction of the primary logo.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast studio photo of three men in black urban 80s fashion (high-top fades, sunglasses) posed against a background of massive, out-of-focus industrial chain links.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply custom geometric white lettering with vertical bar construction over the subjects' clothing and background.

verificationChecks: Are the chain links oversized relative to the subjects?
Is the typography constructed from sharp geometric bars?
Is there high value contrast between the black clothes and light background?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subjects
postGenerationChecks: Check for oversized chain link consistency
Verify typography is geometric and white
Ensure subjects are wearing high-contrast black attire
Confirm the presence of 80s urban styling
recipe.reuseFormula: Industrial background + High-contrast urban subjects + Geometric custom lettering = Retro Funk Aesthetic
